consolidated.root_cause: Local telemetry, controller failure handling, and remote execution lack a shared custody-before-cleanup transaction boundary.
consolidated.title: Destructive cleanup precedes durable evidence custody

work_order_sketch.action: Retain native and remote artifacts until durable bundle custody is confirmed; add an outer controller finalization boundary and independent salvage steps.
work_order_sketch.bounded_scope: controller failure handling, powermetrics capture lifecycle, NodeWorkerClient cleanup policy, and focused failure-injection tests
work_order_sketch.non_goals: Live hardware validation, broad adapter refactoring, or recovery from SIGKILL/power loss

consolidated.root_cause: Config, summary, reducer, exported-schema, BundleReader, and CLI validity semantics are maintained independently rather than derived from shared predicates.
consolidated.title: Duplicated validity rules allow contradictory success and admission states

work_order_sketch.action: Define canonical config and succeeded-summary predicates and enforce parity in writers, reducers, exported schemas, readers, and CLI exit decisions.
work_order_sketch.bounded_scope: schemas.py, bundle_read.py, reduce.py, CLI validation/reduction paths, and rejection-equivalence tests
work_order_sketch.non_goals: Schema-version redesign or unrelated bundle-format changes

consolidated.root_cause: Runtime, replay, and ratio gates lack one authoritative realized-output record and therefore infer exactness, replay support, and stop provenance from configured policy.
consolidated.title: Configured output intent is substituted for realized output evidence

work_order_sketch.action: Create and consume a normalized realized-output outcome containing emitted count and realized stop reason; reject exact/replay/ratio eligibility when it is absent or inconsistent.
work_order_sketch.bounded_scope: MLX single-run and cache-spike paths, output provenance, strict validation, ratio input extraction, and negative tests
work_order_sketch.non_goals: Changing generation policy or defining new token-normalized estimands

consolidated.root_cause: Durable member registration and reconstructable aggregate computation are ordered as one operation instead of committing custody first.
consolidated.title: Experiment manifests are committed after fallible aggregation

work_order_sketch.action: Commit each completed member to the incremental manifest before aggregation, then record aggregate failure separately and retryably.
work_order_sketch.bounded_scope: run_experiment ordering, manifest schema-compatible failure recording, and aggregation-failure tests
work_order_sketch.non_goals: Campaign concurrency or aggregate-method changes

consolidated.root_cause: The default exact-floor path couples calibration identity to claim bundles while failing to bind stored floor observations to the named bundle bytes and metrics; the independent typed resolver remains private.
consolidated.title: Floor resolution is neither independently consumable nor evidence-bound

work_order_sketch.action: Expose a production FloorRequest path and bind every calibration observation to strict-validated bundle bytes, config identity, metric, and summary value before exact or transported resolution.
work_order_sketch.bounded_scope: detection-floor artifact validation, analysis input loading/resolution, public analyze-claims interface, and independent-calibration integration tests
work_order_sketch.non_goals: Collecting Window-A floors or changing floor formulas

consolidated.root_cause: Frozen-n policy has multiple handwritten representations: the executable AP-2 path cannot encode authorized n=10 cells, while copied and candidate plans authorize outcome-dependent growth forbidden by D-062.
consolidated.title: Sample-size authority is fragmented across contracts, generators, and copied campaign rows

work_order_sketch.action: Make pre-freeze sample size explicit and parameterized in the canonical registry/generator, then replace copied top-up rules with references to one frozen-n authority and exploratory-demotion rule.
work_order_sketch.bounded_scope: AP-2 generator/manifest validation plus affected campaign-pack and RQ-variance sizing rows
work_order_sketch.non_goals: Selecting actual n before Window-A evidence or deleting scientific sizing safeguards

consolidated.root_cause: Campaign integrity logic treats absence of expected token evidence as a modality exemption instead of explicit missing evidence for text-tokenized suites.
consolidated.title: Missing prompt-token sidecars fail open as not applicable

work_order_sketch.action: Require an explicit sidecar or explicit policy exemption for text suites and downgrade member usability when expected token evidence is absent.
work_order_sketch.bounded_scope: run_campaign prompt-hash resolution, integrity flags, and missing-sidecar tests
work_order_sketch.non_goals: Changing ID-native suite handling

consolidated.root_cause: The report browser equates a parseable summary with completeness and presents governed token metrics without strict admission, claim status, or required stack identity.
consolidated.title: Generic HTML reports bypass evidence and claim-readiness gates

work_order_sketch.action: Label the surface explicitly diagnostic or add strict-validation and claim-readiness states; co-display request energy, tokenizer, boundary, and provenance wherever token metrics appear.
work_order_sketch.bounded_scope: joulewise/report.py and public-behavior tests
work_order_sketch.non_goals: Turning the browser into the capstone report system

consolidated.root_cause: Publication regeneration copies workload_profile.output_tokens into a runtime_output_tokens field while omitting realized stop/policy evidence required for the token-normalized companion.

work_order_sketch.non_goals: Changing the verified request-energy result or silently rewriting grandfathered artifacts

work_order_sketch.action: Validate response version and task identity before success or cleanup, persist the accepted protocol version, and add stale/collided-response tests.

work_order_sketch.non_goals: A general migration framework for future protocol versions

work_order_sketch.non_goals: Implementing split execution or transfer benchmarking

work_order_sketch.non_goals: Performing NV-GATE-2 or de-provisionalizing any hardware result

work_order_sketch.non_goals: Changing canonical sanitized controller run IDs
